name: E2E-GOV-001 — 三链路独立去重策略（processMode隔离+状态过滤+时间窗口）
description: 验证三条链路的去重策略互不干扰：链路一按replacePic去重，链路二按generateMaterial去重，种草按seedGenerate+72h窗口去重。已COMPLETED/EXECUTING状态记录被过滤，retryCount>0被过滤
module: 上游素材生产链路/治理规则

steps.expression: return (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: '三链路独立去重', dedupMethod: 'filterAlreadyProcessed(records, processMode, lookbackMinutes)', dedupRules: [ { link: '链路一(replacePic)', processMode: 'replacePic', lookbackMinutes: null, recordId: '{itemId}_{imageUrl.hashCode()}', filters: ['retryCount>0→跳过', 'COMPLETED→跳过', 'EXECUTING→跳过'] }, { link: '链路二(generateMaterial)', processMode: 'generateMaterial', lookbackMinutes: null, recordId: '{itemId}_{imageUrl.hashCode()}', filters: ['retryCount>0→跳过', 'COMPLETED→跳过', 'EXECUTING→跳过'] }, { link: '链路三(seedGenerate)', processMode: 'seedGenerate', lookbackMinutes: 4320, recordId: '{itemId}_{imageUrl.hashCode()}', filters: ['retryCount>0→跳过', 'COMPLETED→跳过', 'EXECUTING→跳过', '72h窗口内已处理→跳过'] } ], isolationRules: { keyPoint: '按processMode独立去重', example: '链路一的replacePic记录不影响链路二的generateMaterial去重', upsert: 'recordId幂等upsert，PENDING状态直接覆盖' } }; })()

steps.description: 验证 定义三链路去重规则 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { return { validation: '三链路去重规则', checks: [ { name: 'processMode隔离', expected: '各链路独立', rule: 'replacePic记录不影响generateMaterial去重', pass: true }, { name: 'retryCount过滤', expected: 'retryCount>0跳过', rule: '失败重试的记录不参与去重判断', pass: true }, { name: 'COMPLETED过滤', expected: '已完成跳过', rule: 'COMPLETED状态记录阻止同recordId新记录', pass: true }, { name: 'EXECUTING过滤', expected: '执行中跳过', rule: 'EXECUTING状态记录阻止同recordId新记录', pass: true }, { name: '种草72h窗口', expected: '4320分钟内去重', rule: 'SEED_DEDUP_LOOKBACK_MINUTES=4320', pass: true }, { name: 'PENDING覆盖', expected: 'upsert直接覆盖', rule: 'recordId相同且为PENDING→直接覆盖', pass: true } ] }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证去重规则全项 存在

steps.label: gov-dedup-strategy
steps.description: 截图 - 三链路去重规则验证

_testDesign.preconditions: 同一商品分别走过链路一、链路二、种草链路的完整流程，存在各processMode的历史记录
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.同一商品先走链路一(replacePic)完成 2.再触发链路二(generateMaterial)→验证不被链路一记录去重 3.走种草(seedGenerate)→验证72h窗口 4.验证COMPLETED/EXECUTING状态阻止重复
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①不同processMode的记录互不影响 ②COMPLETED/EXECUTING状态阻止同recordId ③种草72h外可重新处理 ④PENDING记录可被upsert覆盖
_testDesign.dbAssertion: 同itemId不同processMode的记录各自独立存在
riskPoints: 72h窗口过大可能导致种草任务堆积
